title: Juniper Research Unveils Identity & Security Award Winners for 2026
summary: BASINGSTOKE, United Kingdom, Oct. 07, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Juniper Research is excited to announce the winners of our first-ever Future Digital Awards for Identity & Security.
body_markdown:
BASINGSTOKE, United Kingdom, Oct. 07, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) --[Juniper Research](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=snVRhgeKkaQWsAFJmHfleXwbPZq4fEVXQU2PoTMIyP2JBwYF9ilSkSALEqZJjJOBxboPm28SrbLYy-pol4tzipI0CBlPj4ViKlE-gPlNXN709qHYwetBvfwMg2gKNKr36O8DqU0xGSM79U8f3DRVpEH96TPbLMcuph3Jl_Gi7-pFW_5i7dyUp6vUGgMVHNSBiSzVxqVLra0-68ZhmcBy7J_F0_t-hPn_ZySBRTXaPXwA8iYCfJCJfLhNtIeG984b) is excited to announce the winners of our first-ever[Future Digital Awards for Identity & Security](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=V7wJChwCBSB27zRBz5jCgAUfsW3Jzc_rMkW-Wr8foFgs_ceuhCT6tqUs_BQK4H33H_grRBFKxiyP4H3mF8_lDhB3WYnd8Ui7vYfv_T5fU9xbrsqoiiJz3xvNrdWdKgp6x5pOvG39qK2FHps1cPXKsyK0Qpfb5JYCu1DYSERRPJFFphPGYiosdBFnJoYET_Sla-bft0UBuTB6cfspNuruu4sRbt3fhfV4YvShhNp4N8x9Wsw0KKke4nGyqlw6RYIu5pY7pU_huGjYIKSdDKbY6vw3O_6UHjAkXJiLm0l3zSu_4C2AtmwWgqo5MWiP_32UR-MrjX_1IiA0bf97INbXDg==) .


The inaugural[Future Digital Awards](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=V7wJChwCBSB27zRBz5jCgAUfsW3Jzc_rMkW-Wr8foFh4M5Kr3ts0vdacmr36i9VeG9hX7pXrWaaYGaJLc__hykV7tpMwb8oD9WM2XjjhUu0RNnf132kiVVcQq1La6beyUJerielxuQbE69VLqH9wyByWzIwFCnp2yQXK49TqI8cSY5L2cgyevq85L476Wsnaa8p3MwR4cecOpaHGbQrDrjlb25yBjTzaSQ7MPnfVm-wZD1Fq6p7dLOy6hD2Ca4EfjCiaR9Wdv716_ChWZ0St-g==) for Identity & Security recognise both the trailblazers and the market leaders driving the dynamic cybersecurity and digital identity markets; ranging from Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-money Laundering (AML) to post-quantum cryptography and biometric security providers.


These awards draw on Juniper Research’s two decades’ expertise of advising and revealing industries’ front-runners.
